summary: Changes requested: (1) doctor.go doctorPowderCheck/doctorProbeEnv forwards POWDER_API_KEY into the powder subprocess environment and, when that subprocess fails, publishes its stdout/stderr first line as evidence without redaction; a stub powder that wrote the key to stderr produced doctor JSON evidence containing the key, violating the documented contract that evidence/reason never contain credential values. Redact the injected key or emit a fixed non-secret failure reason. (2) runStatus now calls readLedger(root,-1) plus tailRuns instead of ReadLedgerTail, so an empty ledger marshals the status --json recent field as null instead of []; normalize the empty records slice before assigning to the payload.
